summary: The production board, audited content, POI curation, assistant consent and all supported map modes passed visual inspection. Live microphone/listening, browser-console inspection and an exact phone viewport were not exercised.

checks.name: Desktop board shell
checks.evidence: The Leangenbukta board opened with its title, seven themes and 817 de-duplicated places.

checks.name: Audited project knowledge
checks.evidence: Documented project facts appeared under Dokumenterte opplysninger, including the topic-only Hangarbrua fact and the approved Snurr opening-hours fact.

checks.name: Standalone servering places
checks.evidence: Fyr, Franske Nytelser and Burger King Lade Arena appeared as separate markers and list entries. Fyr opened with route time and register details.

checks.name: 2D map
checks.evidence: The map rendered and a selected place showed one detail popup after the duplicate-popup fix.

checks.name: Satellite map
checks.evidence: The satellite layer rendered with POI markers and selection state intact.

checks.name: 3D map
checks.evidence: The 3D layer rendered with POI markers and selection state intact.

checks.name: Assistant consent
checks.evidence: Opening Anja displayed the consent dialog before microphone use. The dialog was cancelled.

checks.name: Narrow viewport
checks.evidence: The board remained coherent after narrowing the native Chrome window to a tablet-like viewport.

checks.name: Exact phone viewport
checks.reason: The selected host-native browser driver did not expose exact viewport emulation.

checks.name: Live microphone and listening state
checks.reason: Microphone permission and live voice interaction were intentionally not granted during this visual pass.

checks.name: Browser console
checks.reason: Console inspection was not exposed through the selected host-native browser driver.

defects.title: Selected POI displayed duplicate popups after switching to 2D
defects.cause: The persistent BoardMap3D layer rendered its HTML popup while it was behind the active Mapbox layer.
defects.resolution: BoardMap3D now renders its selected-place popup only while the 3D layer is in front.
defects.verification: Switching back to 2D showed exactly one selected-place popup.
